bagPolicy.summary: Bags are searched and must fit comfortably under the guest’s seat; oversized bags are prohibited.
allowed: Bag that fits under a seat
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The Apollo suggests nearby third-party parking at Park 127th LLC, 340 St Nicholas Avenue, and a garage on West 127th Street; these are not venue-operated.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by The Apollo’s Historic Theater. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: The Apollo prohibits outside food and beverages and offers accommodations for medical needs on request.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The Historic Theater has 12 orchestra wheelchair seating locations and an elevator to seating levels; contact the box office for assistance. The Historic Theater is closed for renovation with reopening expected in late 2026.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The Apollo visitor guidance does not publish a general re-entry policy for performances.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Buy tickets online through Ticketmaster.com or in person at the box office, which opens two hours before scheduled performances. For help, call the box office at (212) 531-5305 or email access@apollotheater.org.

gates.summary: There is one accessible entrance, at the front of The Apollo on W 125th Street.
